name: Brook Crompton Holdings Ltd.
summary: Brook Crompton Holdings Ltd., an investment holding company, engages in the distribution of electric motors in the United Kingdom, the Asia Pacific, and North America. The company provides its products under the Brook Crompton brand name for marine, oil and gas, and mining sectors, as well as for heating, ventilation, and air conditioning sector. Brook Crompton Holdings Ltd. was formerly known as Lindeteves-Jacoberg Limited and changed its name to Brook Crompton Holdings Ltd. in April 2016. The company was incorporated in 1947 and is based in Singapore. Brook Crompton Holdings Ltd. is a subsidiary of ATB Austria Antriebstechnik AG.
